attributes.board_name: Alabama Board of Examiners in Psychology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by APA-approved sponsors (incl. home, distance, book-based and online study); other live programs (e.g. AMA, NASW, NIMH) if the Board finds them relevant to psychology and documented; presenting up to 6 hours per year
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed under 12 months: 20/12 hours per full month licensed (counting from the first full month after licensure), rounded to the nearest whole hour.
rules.carryover: Up to 6 hours may be carried into the next year only; no longer carryover.
rules.audit_note: CE must be entered in the Board's Licensee Portal before renewal; keep certificates for a possible audit.
rules.notes: CE year runs Oct 1 - Sep 30; license renewal due Oct 15 each year. One hour = at least 50 minutes. Non-APA home-study only counts if APA-approved. No mandatory topics in the rules; DHR mandated reporter training is encouraged but does not count as CE.
